description: This file defines classes and functions for handling JSON-RPC messaging within the WPEFramework core library. It includes message structures, connection handling, method registration, invocation, and notification mechanisms, as well as error handling specific to JSON-RPC protocol implementation.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC message with support for different message types, including request, response, and error messages, with methods for parsing and constructing message components.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC connection with channel ID and sequence number, used for identifying communication sessions.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Manages registration, invocation, and notification of JSON-RPC methods, including handling observers and event subscriptions.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Extracts the callsign part from a designator string.

methods.name: FullCallsign
methods.description: Extracts the full callsign from a designator string.

methods.name: Method
methods.description: Extracts the method name from a designator string.

methods.name: FullMethod
methods.description: Extracts the full method name from a designator string.

methods.name: VersionedFullMethod
methods.description: Extracts the versioned full method name from a designator string.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Retrieves the version number from a designator string.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Extracts the index part from a designator string.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the message or connection object to its default state.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a registered method with given parameters and returns the result.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Registers a client to receive notifications for a specific event.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a client's subscription to a specific event.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Sends notifications to all subscribed clients for a specific event, optionally with parameters.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes a connection or removes all subscriptions for a given client ID.
